response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with a strong track record across many companies, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD systems, or deep-learning workload optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured professional software engineering experience (15+ years)
Demonstrated low-latency systems experience with DLang, async I/O, and high-performance databases
Strong communication and teaching skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture design
No evidence of AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator architecture work
Background is almost entirely web/mobile/full-stack, not systems or hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
